request.style: English, male narrative voice, solo acoustic guitar, soft fiddle, warm piano, gentle percussion, mournful yet dignified mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sarah died in Hebron land
A hundred twenty-seven years she stayed
Abrose up to speak the word
A stranger in the foreign world

[Verse]
I am a sojourner among you
Give me a burial site to view
The Hittites spoke with gentle voice
You are a prince before God's choice

[Chorus]
Ephron sat in the city gate
Said I give you field and cave
No, my lord, hear me please
I will pay the price with ease

[Verse]
Abraham bowed before the crowd
And told them all what they should
Plead with Ephron son of Zohar
To sell the cave and open door

[Chorus]
Ephron sat in the city gate
Said I give you field and cave
No, my lord, hear me please
I will pay the price with ease

[Bridge]
Four hundred shekels silver weighed
In the hearing of the people
Abraham agreed to terms
And bought the land with his arms

[Verse]
The field of Machpelah passed
Into the hand of the father
All trees within the border
Now belong to him forever

[Chorus]
Ephron sat in the city gate
Said I give you field and cave
No, my lord, hear me please
I will pay the price with ease

[Outro]
Buried Sarah in the cave
In the land of Canaan
